en.metaTitle: Right Triangle Area Calculator – Calculate Area of Right Triangle
en.metaDescription: Calculate the area of a right triangle from two legs, leg and hypotenuse, or side and acute angle with step-by-step mathematical formulas and conversions.
en.description: Calculate right triangle area using any known combination of dimensions: two legs, one leg and hypotenuse, or hypotenuse/leg and an acute angle. Includes step-by-step derivations.
en.shortDescription: Calculate the area, missing sides, perimeter, and angles of any right triangle instantly.
en.intro: Compute right triangle area from two legs, a leg and hypotenuse, or side and acute angle. Includes geometric step-by-step proofs, unit conversions, and special 45°-45°-90° isosceles calculations.
en.formulaDescription: In Euclidean geometry, the area of a right triangle with perpendicular legs a and b is half the area of a rectangle of identical dimensions: Area = (a × b) / 2. When the hypotenuse c is known, missing sides are calculated via the Pythagorean theorem c² = a² + b² or standard trigonometric ratios.
en.formulaEquation: Area = (a · b) / 2  |  c = √(a² + b²)  |  b = √(c² - a²)  |  Area = ½ · c² · sin(α) · cos(α)

faqs.question: How do you calculate the area of a right triangle?
faqs.answer: Multiply the lengths of the two perpendicular legs together and divide by 2: Area = (a × b) / 2. Because the legs meet at a 90-degree angle, one leg serves as the base and the other serves as the perpendicular height.

faqs.question: How do you find the area if you only know one leg and the hypotenuse?
faqs.answer: First use the Pythagorean theorem to determine the missing leg: b = √(c² − a²). Once both legs are known, calculate Area = (a × b) / 2.

faqs.question: Can I calculate the area using the hypotenuse and an angle?
faqs.answer: Yes. If hypotenuse c and acute angle α are known, the legs are a = c × sin(α) and b = c × cos(α). The area is Area = (c² × sin(α) × cos(α)) / 2.

faqs.question: What is the area of a 45°-45°-90° right triangle?
faqs.answer: A 45°-45°-90° right triangle is an isosceles right triangle where both legs are equal (a = b). The area is Area = a² / 2. Expressed in terms of the hypotenuse c, Area = c² / 4.

faqs.question: समकोण त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल कैसे निकालते हैं?
faqs.answer: समकोण त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल निकालने के लिए आधार और लम्ब की लम्बाई का गुणा करके 2 से भाग दें: क्षेत्रफल = (आधार × लम्ब) / 2।

faqs.question: यदि केवल एक भुजा और कर्ण पता हो तो क्षेत्रफल कैसे निकालें?
faqs.answer: पहले पाइथागोरस प्रमेय से दूसरी भुजा निकालें: b = √(c² − a²)। फिर क्षेत्रफल सूत्र (a × b) / 2 का प्रयोग करें।

faqs.question: 45°-45°-90° समद्विबाहु समकोण त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल क्या होता है?
faqs.answer: इसमें दोनों भुजाएं बराबर (a = b) होती हैं। इसका क्षेत्रफल a² / 2 होता है, या कर्ण c के रूप में c² / 4 होता है।

ko.intro: 피타고라스 정리와 삼각비를 사용하여 직각삼각형의 넓이와 변의 길이를 단계별로 신속하게 계산할 수 있습니다.
ko.formulaDescription: 직교하는 두 변을 a와 b라고 할 때, 직각삼각형의 넓이는 넓이 = (a × b) / 2 입니다. 빗변 c는 피타고라스 정리 c² = a² + b²에 의해 계산됩니다.
ko.formulaEquation: 넓이 = (a · b) / 2  |  c = √(a² + b²)  |  b = √(c² - a²)

stepByStep: 알고 있는 치수 조합(두 변, 변과 빗변, 각도 등)을 선택합니다.
빈 입력 필드에 수치를 입력합니다.
원하는 측정 단위(cm, m, mm 등)를 선택합니다.
계산하기 버튼을 눌러 넓이와 단계별 풀이 과정을 확인합니다.

faqs.question: 직각삼각형의 넓이는 어떻게 구하나요?
faqs.answer: 직각을 이루는 두 변(밑변과 높이)을 곱한 뒤 2로 나눕니다: 넓이 = (a × b) / 2.

it.name: Calcolatore Area Triangolo Rettangolo
it.title: Calcolatore Area Triangolo Rettangolo – Area e Ipotenusa
it.metaTitle: Calcolatore Area Triangolo Rettangolo – Area e Ipotenusa
it.metaDescription: Calcola l'area di un triangolo rettangolo da due cateti, cateto e ipotenusa o angoli con formule e passaggi matematici dettagliati.
it.description: Calcola area, ipotenusa, perimetro e angoli di qualsiasi triangolo rettangolo con spiegazioni passo dopo passo.
it.shortDescription: Calcola l'area e i lati di un triangolo rettangolo in modo semplice.
it.intro: Calcola l'area del triangolo rettangolo partendo da cateti, ipotenusa o angoli acuti tramite il teorema di Pitagora e la trigonometria.
it.formulaTitle: Formule per l'Area del Triangolo Rettangolo
it.formulaDescription: L'area di un triangolo rettangolo con cateti perpendicolari a e b è data da Area = (a × b) / 2. L'ipotenusa c si calcola con il teorema di Pitagora c² = a² + b².
it.formulaEquation: Area = (a · b) / 2  |  c = √(a² + b²)  |  b = √(c² - a²)

workedExample.result: Area: 24 cm², Ipotenusa: 10 cm, Perimetro: 24 cm

faqs.question: Come si calcola l'area di un triangolo rettangolo?
faqs.answer: Si moltiplicano le misure dei due cateti perpendicolari e si divide il risultato per 2: Area = (a × b) / 2.
